items.title: Holy shit holy shit holy shit holy shit: The magnitude of what’s now happening
items.blurb: I feel like my previous posts (and post titles), and podcasts, and talks, have failed to do full justice to the magnitude of what's now happening, so I'm trying again. Last night, we had friends and colleagues over for dinner.

items.title: A seminal moment in computing
items.blurb: MG, founder and CEO of WorkOS, is back to talk about leading a company through what DHH called a seminal moment in computing.

items.title: The Mythology of Conscious AI
items.blurb: Why consciousness is more likely a property of life than of computation and why creating conscious, or even conscious-seeming AI, is a bad idea.

items.title: Restricting AI agents in mobile operating systems platforms from capturing data
Recap of Microsoft Ignite 2026: Copilot as the Work OS and Agent Governance
items.blurb: At Ignite 2026, Microsoft positioned Copilot as the operating system for work and extended agent identity, governance, and cost controls across Azure, Foundry, Entra, and Defender.

items.title: QCon San Francisco 2026: The Harness Is the New Operating System
items.blurb: At QCon San Francisco 2026, Mad Labs founder and CEO Manju Rajashekhar opened the conference arguing that the harness around an AI model, rather than the model itself, decides what an agent can do and how safely it does it.

items.title: The New York Times warns photographers not to update Photoshop over AI features
items.blurb: The New York Times is warning freelance photographers against using the latest version of Adobe Photoshop, saying it uses AI “in ways that may not be apparent to users.”
